correctness.rationale: For each fixed \(n\ge3\) and R, Poincaré-disk angles give \(A=\sum F_C(g)\), with the correct atan2 branch. The derivative \(F_C\prime\) has strict pairwise gap-averaging monotonicity, so the regular polygon is the unique maximizer. Expansion at fixed positive gaps proves almost-sure convergence to the normalized cotangent sum. Exchangeable anchored circular gaps are exactly \(\operatorname{Dirichlet}(1,\ldots,1)\). Simultaneous small-gap probability O(\(t^{-2a}\)) for a in (1/2,1) isolates one \(8/g\) divergence and proves coefficient \(4n(n-1)/\pi\), moment cutoff and conditional gap marks. Taylor expansion at the unique regular minimum gives Hessian \(H_n\sum u_i^2\), coordinate determinant n, exact \(K_n\), and uniform-ellipsoid blow-up. Standalone checker at its actual package path passed 1310 fixed-seed assertions; finite tests are not used to prove limits. No joint R/t uniform estimates are asserted.
